# Oregon State University College of Engineering

> Academic research and faculty resources for Oregon State's engineering programs, featuring faculty profiles, publications, and computational research across electrical engineering and computer science.

This section of the Oregon State University engineering website hosts faculty homepages, research publications, and academic resources for the School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science. It serves as a hub for accessing faculty expertise, research outputs, and academic materials.
